name: stellar-connect-button
title: Stellar Connect Button
description: Connect wallet button and address display powered by stellar-hooks.

files.content:
import { useFreighter } from 'stellar-hooks';
export function StellarConnectButton(){ const { isConnected, connect, publicKey } = useFreighter(); return <button onClick={connect}>{isConnected ? publicKey : 'Connect Wallet'}</button>; }
export function StellarAddressDisplay({ address }: { address?: string | null }){ if(!address) return null; return {address.slice(0,4)}...{address.slice(-4)}; }
